title: Cárdenas y México
goal: Read how Lázaro Cárdenas's austere style, peasant-based reform, and 1938 oil nationalization contrast with Perón's populism, and why his legacy is far less divisive in Mexico.
grammar: A diferencia de: comparar dos casos

items: Describe Cárdenas's personal style, unlike Perón's.
Explain which social group Cárdenas relied on, unlike Perón.
State what decision Cárdenas made in March 1938.
Name the company that resulted from the oil nationalization.
